retrievalProfile.description: A classic country music aesthetic featuring a male subject in western attire against a soft-focus architectural background with layered serif typography.
triggerTerms: cowboy hat portrait with blue background

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man in a black cowboy hat and denim shirt leaning on a white decorative railing, set against a blurred blue building with white shutters, featuring large-scale serif text in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the left third, looking toward the right
Typography anchored in the upper right negative space
Foreground railing creates a horizontal base for the subject
Cool blue background tones contrast with the warm skin tones and black clothing
coreInvariants: Black cowboy hat with a wide brim
Soft-focus architectural background with vertical shutter lines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the dark silhouette of the cowboy hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze to the right, then moves up to the large display text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper right area, occupied by the architectural background and typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and white architectural background
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black of the hat and shirt
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light blue glow/shadow on the typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark subject and the bright, airy background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical serif with high stroke contrast
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and weight contrast within the same serif family.
graphicDevices: Soft drop shadows to separate text from the busy background

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classical, sharp serif aesthetic of the era.
Provides the necessary stroke contrast and elegant feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a man in a black cowboy hat and black denim shirt leaning on a white ornate metal railing. The background should be a soft-focus blue building with white shutters and a vertical white pillar on the far right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, right-aligned uppercase serif text in the upper right corner. The top two lines should be light blue with a soft shadow, and the bottom line should be smaller, white, and more widely spaced.

verificationChecks: Is the subject wearing a black cowboy hat?
Is the text right-aligned in the upper right quadrant?
Is the background primarily blue and white architectural elements?
Is the railing visible in the foreground?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue background hue
mustRedesign: Do not use modern sans-serif fonts
Do not place the subject in the center
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the subject's face
Ensure the blue drop shadow on the text is subtle and not muddy
Verify the subject's hat is a distinct black silhouette
Confirm the railing appears as a physical foreground element
